barrel-files: tie, 4/4 both configs. The base model already gives the right barrel advice unaided, so this eval is a regression guard, not a discriminator. It confirms the new SKILL section doesn't break the answer.

central-types: with_skill 4/4 across all runs; one without_skill run defended keeping the central types.ts (the weaker answer), dropping baseline to ~0.83. Mild but real edge - the skill reliably steers to co-locate-by-default where the base model occasionally drifts to defending the status quo.
